business_summary: HMH Holding Inc. provides offshore and onshore oil and gas drilling equipment and systems and services in the United States and Norway. The company's services include sales of projects and products including drilling equipment packages for newbuild or a reactivated drilling rig, and individual or grouped components of drilling and pressure control equipment. The company also offers aftermarket services including services and replacement parts on installed equipment and integrated digital solutions. The company sells equipment and services to drilling contractors; operators, including both oil and gas E&P companies and mining companies onshore and offshore; and manufacturers, consisting of shipyards and manufacturers of capital equipment. In addition, the company also offers equipment and services to the onshore and subsea mining industry. The company offers equipment under two categories: pressure control systems, including Blowout Preventers; and topside equipment comprising hoisting and rotating systems and drilling circulating systems. Its pressure control systems include blowout preventers (BOPs), BOP control systems, drilling risers, and wellhead connectors. The company's topside equipment includes hoisting and rotating systems, such as top drive, iron roughneck and pipe handling, and derrick and drawworks; and drilling circulating systems, such as mud pumps, slurry pumps, and mud mixing and control systems. The company's aftermarket services include transactional services on installed equipment, such as the manufacturing and sale of replacement spare parts, overhaul and repair of installed equipment, recertifications and field labor; and integrated solutions to provide comprehensive digital solutions. Additionally, it develops digital solutions for remote drilling automation and condition-based monitoring. HMH Holding Inc. was founded in 1895 and is headquartered in Houston, Texas.
business_summary_ko: HMH Holding Inc.는 미국과 노르웨이에서 해상 및 육상 석유 및 가스 시추 장비와 시스템, 서비스를 제공합니다. 회사의 서비스에는 신조 또는 재활성화된 굴착 장치용 시추 장비 패키지, 시추 및 압력 제어 장비의 개별 또는 그룹 구성 요소를 포함한 프로젝트 및 제품 판매가 포함됩니다. 또한 이 회사는 설치된 장비 및 통합 디지털 솔루션에 대한 서비스 및 교체 부품을 포함한 애프터마켓 서비스도 제공합니다. 회사는 시추 계약자에게 장비와 서비스를 판매합니다. 석유 및 가스 E&P 회사와 육상 및 해상 광산 회사를 포함한 운영업체; 조선소 및 자본 장비 제조업체로 구성된 제조업체. 또한 회사는 육상 및 해저 광산 업계에 장비와 서비스도 제공합니다. 이 회사는 분출 방지 장치를 포함한 압력 제어 시스템, 두 가지 범주의 장비를 제공합니다. 호이스팅 및 회전 시스템과 드릴링 순환 시스템으로 구성된 상부 장비. 압력 제어 시스템에는 폭발 방지 장치(BOP), BOP 제어 시스템, 드릴링 라이저 및 웰헤드 커넥터가 포함됩니다. 회사의 최고
